cues.text: You run into the entrance hall of Tartarus with Akihiko, Junpei and Fuuka and stop short. You, Akihiko and Junpei raise your fists, ready to fight.

A motorcycle lies smoking on the floor. At the foot of the great staircase stand two giant Shadows: one tall and thin, with long dangling arms and a cross down its body; the other round, with a fan of feathers behind its head. Mitsuru and Yukari are down on the floor near the stairs.
A girl in a school uniform walks into the hall, toward the Shadows. You, Akihiko and Junpei rush forward.
Fuuka runs across the hall to Natsuki.
Natsuki sinks to her knees in front of Fuuka. Behind them, the two Shadows turn toward the girls.
Fuuka turns around to face the Shadows, with Natsuki kneeling behind her.
